dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale margins on folded primary and secondary feathers create a prominent linear boundary against darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct demarcation line is visible where the fine longitudinal streaks of the greyish crown meet the larger scalloped patterns of the brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible cream-colored lateral neck/auricular patch and a dark malar stripe on the face.
